drums.tags: Trap with heavy cinematic sound design elements. The track features a distorted 808 bass that slides between notes, layered with a sharp, metallic snare and crisp hi-hat rolls. A dark, atmospheric synth pad provides a constant harmonic wash in the background. Prominent sound effects include high-velocity bullet whizzes, metallic clinks, and explosive impacts that are synchronized with the rhythmic grid. A high-pitched, dissonant synth lead enters periodically with short, staccato stabs. The tempo is 140 BPM in the key of C minor.
